roomIDs.description: Filter by room ID. If more than one, send as a comma-separated list, i.e. 101-0,101-3. A room ID has the form {roomTypeID}-{index} and is the same value this endpoint returns as data.roomID. Combined with the other filters using AND. A value that is not of that form is rejected with a 400 response. A well-formed ID that matches no room of this property is not an error - it simply contributes no result. An empty value applies no room filter, so every room of the property is returned.

'no_show' - Guest didn't showed up on check-in date
